$comment: setspec prompt.manifest 1.0 -- hand-authored: a pack's manifest.json is validated by setspec.prompts.load_pack (see _check_manifest), never an envelope payload. Describes the shape build_manifest()/write_manifest() produce.
title: prompt.manifest

prompts.description: One entry per shipped record, sorted by (prompt_id, version).

sha256.description: prompt_record_hash(record) -- over the record's canonical JSON, not its file bytes.

pack_sha256.description: pack_hash(references) over the sorted (prompt_id, version, sha256) triples of every entry in `prompts`. Provenance only -- never a fingerprint input (ADR-0028 §1).
